safetyInvariantResults.description: Strategic Reserve requires an explicit reserve signal.
Explicit Strategic Reserve is never classified as Dead Stock Candidate.
Recurring intermittent demand is not classified as Dead Stock Candidate from age or coverage alone.
Dead Stock Candidate requires an independent demand, planning or lifecycle signal.
Missing or insufficient History produces the existing non-definitive condition.
Low History completeness limits the classification.
Ambiguous relationships cannot produce a definitive Slow / Dead condition.
Unit conflicts cannot produce a definitive quantity-based condition.
Project or one-time demand is not automatically treated as normal Dead Stock.
The 6, 12 and 18 month boundaries are deterministic and inclusive as defined by policy.
A numeric zero remains distinguishable from missing evidence.
Repeated evaluation of the same fixture is deterministic.
